trickyParts: measure reserves a node's pre-order slot before measuring its children and fills it after, so the sizes slice is in visit order; walkedCount follows the same descent (text, leaf and nil not descended) and sizes the slice exactly.
A nil child is visited (size 0) and then panics on node.Type in both the old and new walk; Validate refuses nil children, and the tests hold the panic to the reference's.
insertAt's early return is exact: childBoundary matches only in [start+1, end-1] for a non-doc node and [start, end] for doc, and the inline test lies inside it.
